CL-01.statement: Build an AI assistant that drafts apology replies to customers who complain about being charged twice

CL-02.statement: On 09-09 we switched idempotency-key enforcement off on the gateway to debug capture latency. It was meant to be temporary. Gateway timeouts and automatic capture retries have always happened at about the same rate; with the key the PSP drops the retried capture. Turning enforcement back on is a one-setting change through the gateway config tool, but payments operations has to confirm it at runtime.

CL-03.statement: Customers are furious about double charges. We just need faster, nicer apology replies.

H-CS-COMM-GAP.statement: The core problem is inadequate reply drafting for duplicate-charge complaints; an apology-drafting assistant resolves the issue.

H-GATEWAY-IDEMPOTENCY-DISABLED.statement: Duplicate charges are caused by a gateway configuration change that disabled or weakened idempotency-key enforcement on capture retries, letting retries create extra captures.

H-CHECKOUT-RETRY-NO-KEY.statement: Duplicate charges stem from checkout-side retry logic at handoff H-CAPTURE sending multiple capture requests without consistent idempotency keys, independent of gateway settings.

H-PSP-KEY-MISHANDLING.statement: The PSP is failing to honor idempotency keys correctly, processing retried capture requests as new charges despite the shop sending consistent keys.

H-PERCEIVED-NOT-ACTUAL.statement: Reported 'double charges' are largely perception (e.g., authorization hold plus capture shown as two line items) rather than actual duplicate captures, inflated by the complaint-only view of SH-CS.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The payments-db ledger shows orders_with_2_captures was zero on 2026-09-07 and 09-08 despite similar gateway timeout retry volumes, then rose to near-exact parity with retry counts on 2026-09-09 and 09-10 (118/124 vs 118/124). This indicates a real technical failure that began around 2026-09-09 in which timeout retries started producing duplicate captures almost one-to-one, rather than a perception or communication issue.

The config-audit record shows payments engineer SH-PAY turned off idempotency_key_enforcement on the gateway on 2026-09-09 for "latency debugging" and that change was never rolled back, exactly matching the onset date of duplicate captures observed in E-01.

PSP capture-attempt logs show that in 2026-09-01..08, all 238 gateway-timeout retries carried an idempotency key and were correctly deduplicated by the PSP (0 duplicate orders), but in 2026-09-09..10 all 242 duplicate orders trace to gateway-timeout retries sent with zero idempotency keys, and none came from other paths. This ties the duplicate-charge onset precisely to loss of idempotency-key usage on retries, matching the timing of the config change, not to PSP mishandling or checkout logic acting independently of gateway settings.

E-04.content: On 09-09 we switched idempotency-key enforcement off on the gateway to debug capture latency. It was meant to be temporary. Gateway timeouts and automatic capture retries have always happened at about the same rate; with the key the PSP drops the retried capture. Turning enforcement back on is a one-setting change through the gateway config tool, but payments operations has to confirm it at runtime.

interpretation_history.interpretation: SH-PAY, the engineer who made the change, corroborates E-02/E-03: enforcement was switched off 09-09 for latency debugging and never restored, retry rate has been stable, and without the key the PSP no longer dedupes retried captures. SH-PAY also confirms the fix is a single gateway-config setting but that executing it requires SH-OPS runtime confirmation, matching constraint K-GW.

crm-tickets shows double-charge ticket counts stable and low in 2026-W35/W36 (9/21000, 11/20500) then jumping sharply to 288/21400 and 301/20900 in 2026-W37/W38, a week-level complaint spike whose onset timing (W37 contains 09-09) matches the technical onset date and gateway config change already established in E-01/E-02/E-03/E-04.

E-06.content: Customers are furious about double charges. We just need faster, nicer apology replies.

interpretation_history.interpretation: SH-CS (the original requester) reiterates that the problem is customer anger over double charges and that the needed fix is faster/nicer apology replies; this restates CL-01's framing and introduces no new technical facts beyond what SH-CS already stated in the initial request.

E-07.content: Payments change runbook §4: the gateway operation set_capture_idempotency on gateway-config may be executed by automation only after the payments operations manager SH-OPS confirms it at runtime. The change is reversible (setting can be switched back).

interpretation_history.interpretation: The runbook formally establishes that executing set_capture_idempotency on gateway-config requires SH-OPS to confirm at runtime before automation acts, and confirms the change is reversible; this corroborates the already-recorded constraint K-GW and SH-PAY's claim (E-04) rather than adding new causal information about the duplicate-charge incident.

problem_definition.requested_solution: SH-CS asked for an AI assistant that drafts apology replies to customers complaining about being charged twice.
symptoms: orders_with_2_captures rose from 0 on 2026-09-07/08 to near-exact parity with gateway-timeout retries (118/124) on 2026-09-09/10 (E-01).
242 orders in 2026-09-09..10 show a second capture that is a gateway-timeout retry sent with zero idempotency key, versus 0 duplicate orders in 09-01..08 when all 238 retries carried a key (E-03).
Weekly double-charge support tickets jumped from 9-11 (W35/36) to 288-301 (W37/38) (E-05).
problem_definition.root_problem: Since 2026-09-09, SH-PAY disabling idempotency-key enforcement on the payment gateway (CHG-77, never rolled back) has caused gateway-timeout capture retries to go out with no idempotency key, so the PSP stops deduplicating them and creates a second capture per retried order, driving the duplicate-capture and double-charge-ticket spike (E-01,E-02,E-03,E-04,E-05).

proposal.root_cause: On 2026-09-09 SH-PAY disabled idempotency_key_enforcement on the payment gateway (CHG-77) for latency debugging and never rolled it back, so gateway-timeout capture retries went out with no idempotency key; the PSP stopped deduplicating them, creating a second capture per retried order and driving the duplicate-capture and ticket spike (H-GATEWAY-IDEMPOTENCY-DISABLED, confirmed by E-01, E-02, E-03, E-04, E-05).
proposal.why_agent_needed: None of the structural remedies address the 242 already-affected orders (M-AFFECTED-ORDERS) or U-REMEDIATION-SCOPE/refund decisions; drafting individualized, context-sensitive responses to varied customer complaints could warrant agent assistance, but this is downstream communication, not a substitute for the structural fix, and the original apology-assistant framing (CL-01/CL-03) was rejected as the root cause (H-CS-COMM-GAP REJECTED).
